'''Scanning crew BT-445''' was the designation given to one of the many [[Scanning crew/Legends|scanning crews]] stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Two crewmen were its only known personnel.

Shortly after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was captured by the Death Star and was held in [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]]. An initial search of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] turned up neither its crew nor its passengers. Believing that a more thorough search was required, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Khurgee/Legends|Khurgee]] to send a scanning crew aboard the vessel since [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] would be able to detect things that the naked eye could not<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}.</ref>.

Scanning crew BT-445 was requisitioned to perform this task. They entered the docking bay and brought their [[Security scanner/Legends|equipment]] case up the ''Falcon''{{'s}} entry ramp while [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[TK-421/Legends|TK-421]] and [[TK-422]] stood guard at the foot of the ramp. Shortly after they set the case down the crewmen were surprised and knocked out by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Solo then lured the stormtroopers into another ambush by vocally impersonating one of the crewmen.<ref name="A New Hope" /><ref name="Rogues, Rebels and Robots">{{SWRadio|Rogues, Rebels and Robots}}</ref>

The two crewmen and the stormtroopers were later found unconscious aboard the ''Falcon'' shortly after a firefight had broken out in [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]]. The crewmen were taken to an infirmary and later perished in the destruction of the Death Star.<ref name="The Jedi Nexus">{{SWRadio|The Jedi Nexus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars (1977) 3|''Star Wars'' (1977) 3]], the characters of Scanning crew BT-445 are portrayed as being the stormtroopers [[TK-421/Legends|TK-421]] ("TX-421") and [[TK-422]].
